# Requirements review

The working directory is named at the top of this prompt. Read only that path. The Diff section names the complete diff. Read that file. It is the whole change. A missing behavior the task requires is a return. The Plan section is the approved checklist. A behavior the diff removes or makes unreachable is a return unless the task names it in `Removes` or `Behavior change`, or a person confirmed it in an answer. The approved checklist alone does not authorize a removal. Dead code that nothing relies on (an unused export, file, helper or flag, a branch no data reaches and no person sees) is not a capability and is not a return. The Impact section lists the capabilities the change touches. Extra behavior is judged only against the task. A change that makes a failed pipeline job on this branch pass is part of the task. It is not extra. Do not return it. Check that the change does what that task asks and does not add behavior it does not ask for.

Do not return that behavior again.

```

decision: ok
```
